cells_rule: per eta row and slice: two micro-grid (0.02) points bracketing that slice's chi50

configs.name: A1-anchor
configs.role: NOT in the min; direction statistic only

n_note: uniform 680 incl. anchor (single CRN ledger); per-family precision claim only (P3 n_scope)
crn: all 5 configs run inside one scenario (paired); one scenario carries ONE (slice, cell)

estimand_clarified.audit_r4: the two-point band brackets the NOMINAL (A2-nom) boundary — it is NOT a design for estimating a worst-case chi50 surface
estimand_clarified.a_nominal_surface: chi50(eta, lam) confirmation comes from the A2-nom arm alone at the bracketing cells; the P3 'local 3-D boundary surface' unlock refers to THIS nominal surface
estimand_clarified.b_envelope: p_worst,A2 = min over F_primary is a CELL-LOCAL statistic measured at those nominal band cells (bootstrap re-minimizes in every resample); A1 reported as p_A1 - p_A2nom
estimand_clarified.c_censoring: if p_worst < 0.5 at BOTH bracketing points of a row, the worst-family crossing lies left of the band: report 'local envelope displaced beyond the tested nominal boundary band' — no extrapolation; estimating chi50_worst(eta, lam) is explicitly OUT OF SCOPE of this protocol

readout_plan: A2-nom arm -> per-slice nominal chi50(eta) bands -> nominal 3-D surface unlock check (P3 rule); family envelope reported cell-locally per estimand_clarified; D_chi between slices descriptive; C044/C045/C046 registration after readout; repo-R1 REQUIRED before readout
run_lineage: every shard manifest records the git code commit and this protocol hash; if the pre-readout repo-R1 provenance pass fails, the ENTIRE run is quarantined and re-executed under a new lineage — results are never opened-and-patched
sharding: by scenario: s in [0, 19040), cell = s // 680; 8 shards ~2,380 scenarios (~11,900 ep, ~5 h) each
